result.summary: Found 3 issues: overlapping/corrupted text in the delivery info line, a horizontally cut-off card in the 'Fastest near you' section, and inconsistent heart icon styling between cards.

issues.description: Text under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows overlapping/garbled text reading '25-3€0 mdielivery' which appears to be two overlapping strings (delivery time and delivery cost)
issues.suggestion: Fix the text rendering so delivery time and delivery fee are displayed as separate, clearly readable elements (e.g., '25-30 min • €0 delivery')

issues.description: The third card 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the edge of the screen, showing only a partial view
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll affordance is clear (e.g., partial card should be intentionally shown as a scroll hint, or add fade/gradient edge to indicate more content)

issues.description: Heart/favorite icon styling is inconsistent between cards - white heart with no background on the ramen card vs. dark circular background on the pizza card below
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon button style (background, color, and border) across all promotional/restaurant cards for visual consistency
